title: Gifts of Grace
intro: Paul teaches about the gifts of the Spirit and how they should function in the church. All gifts are given for the common good, and no gift is more important than another.

items.title: Word of wisdom
items.text: One receives a word of wisdom through the Spirit. The ability to speak God's wisdom in concrete situations.

items.title: Word of knowledge
items.text: Another receives a word of knowledge through the same Spirit. Insight into God's truths.

items.title: Faith
items.text: One receives faith through the same Spirit. A special confidence that God will act.

items.title: Healing
items.text: Another receives gifts for healing through the one Spirit.

items.title: Miraculous powers
items.text: One receives power to perform mighty deeds. Miracles and wonders.

items.title: Prophecy
items.text: Another receives the gift of prophecy. To speak God's word into situations.

items.title: Discernment of spirits
items.text: One receives the ability to discern spirits. To distinguish between truth and falsehood.

items.title: Tongues
items.text: Another receives different kinds of tongues. Prayer in an unknown language.

items.title: Interpretation of tongues
items.text: And yet another receives interpretation of tongues. To translate the message spoken in tongues.
